claims: As of March 18, 2026, Micheál Martin is the Taoiseach of Ireland.
Micheál Martin took office on January 23, 2025.
Micheál Martin serves as the head of government.
Micheál Martin leads the cabinet.
Micheál Martin appoints government members.
Micheál Martin maintains majority support in the Dáil Éireann.
The Taoiseach makes annual St. Patrick's Day visits to Washington D.C.
Micheál Martin has been the Taoiseach since January 23, 2025.
The Taoiseach is the leader of Ireland's central executive authority.
The Taoiseach nominates other members of the government for appointment by the President.
The Taoiseach leads the Dáil Éireann.
Dáil Éireann is the Irish Parliament.
The Taoiseach directs government policy.
The Taoiseach represents Ireland on the international stage.
The Taoiseach attends European Council meetings.
The Taoiseach negotiates with international leaders.
The Taoiseach is appointed by the President of Ireland upon the nomination of the Dáil Éireann.
The Taoiseach must retain the support of a majority in the Dáil Éireann.
Taoiseach is an Irish word for chief or leader.
Taoiseach has been used in this context since the 1937 Constitution of Ireland.
The Department of the Taoiseach supports the Taoiseach.
The Department of the Taoiseach is located in Dublin.
Roinn an Taoisigh is the Irish name for the Department of the Taoiseach.
Ireland had a rotation agreement from 2020 to 2025.
The rotation agreement alternated leadership roles between the Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael parties.
The salary for the Taoiseach is frequently reported at roughly €200,000+ per year as of recent years.
